title: anytopdf configuration file
description: The TOML file read from the user config directory or --config. Top-level scalar keys are global settings. Every other top-level table holds one plugin's options: [image], [video], [ocr] and [captions] for built-ins (unknown keys rejected), and [NAME] for a runtime plugin, passed to it verbatim in each request. Each option KEY in table [TYPE] is also ANYTOPDF_TYPE_KEY in the environment and --type-key on `anytopdf convert`.

strict.description: Fail before publishing when ingestion or rendering reports warnings (--strict).

fail_fast.description: Abort without publishing when any input fails (--fail-fast).

include_hidden.description: Include hidden files and directories during discovery (--include-hidden).

filter.description: Only convert discovered inputs whose path matches this regular expression (--filter).

provenance_page.description: Add the provenance page to the PDF (false = --no-provenance-page).

plugin_timeout.description: Maximum seconds for each runtime plugin invocation (--plugin-timeout).

plugin_sandbox.description: Confine runtime plugins (--plugin-sandbox); unset keeps the per-command default.

allow_plugin_kind.description: Register only these plugin capability kinds (--allow-plugin-kind).

plugin_sandbox_allow_read.description: Extra paths a strict-sandboxed plugin may read (--plugin-sandbox-allow-read).

renderer.description: Renderer that writes the output: pdfa (tagged PDF/A-3a), pdf (printpdf) or runtime:NAME (--renderer).

plugin_table.description: Options for a runtime plugin, passed verbatim in its requests.

max_frames.description: Frames to import from a multi-frame TIFF or GIF; 0 means unlimited.

dedupe_distance.description: Perceptual-hash distance below which frames count as duplicates.

embedded_subtitles.description: Read subtitle tracks embedded in video files.
